name: kyde-score-skill
description: Kyde Score plugins: behavioral drift scoring for AI agents (score.kyde.com). kyde-score sets up any OpenTelemetry harness; kyde-score-cowork adds the hooks for Claude Desktop and Cowork.

plugins.name: kyde-score
plugins.description: Claude Code / any OpenTelemetry harness: create a scoring key, point the OTel exporter at the service, verify ingest, optionally add the MCP server for in-session drift checks. Skill-based setup, no hooks.

plugins.name: kyde-score-cowork
plugins.description: Claude Desktop / Cowork: hooks report each tool call to score.kyde.com (never content), warn on drift, and hold a call outside the human-confirmed contract (Pro and up). Includes the kyde-score MCP server (remote) and the setup skill.
